name: mesh-9a344c91-blind30-ots
instr:
# Traefik Mesh gives wrong answers across status queries, cluster-model building and generated routing — without a test suite

The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything I have been able to observe from the outside.

An installation of this software runs inside a cluster, watches what people declare there, works out a picture of who may talk to whom over which ports, and turns that picture into the dynamic configuration a proxy consumes. It also answers questions about itself over HTTP. Nothing about the cluster changed and nothing about the callers changed, yet it now gets a great many of these things wrong, and in several places work that used to be done is refused outright.

Asking a running instance over HTTP for the configuration it is currently serving no longer gives that configuration back: with a document stored, the body that comes back is an error rather than the stored JSON. The endpoint that lists the participating nodes fails the same way — an empty cluster, a cluster with one ready pod, and a cluster with one non-ready pod all produce an error instead of the expected JSON array. Asking for the configuration of one named node whose pod exists and answers also comes back as a failure, whereas asking for a name that is not present still yields the not-found reply it always did.

Restricting which parts of the cluster are looked at has collapsed. With no restriction configured at all, every object is reported as one to be
